title: 第一百六十三章 中医师教授刁难，一鸣惊人！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这个病例比前两个更难。

肠易激综合征迁延不愈，久病耗伤正气，脾虚、肾虚、肝郁、湿困、瘀阻，各种病机交织在一起，单纯健脾或者单纯止泻都治不好。

王大壮皱了皱眉，想了想，开口了。

“六年腹泻，久病必虚，久病必瘀。脾虚是肯定的，六年下来脾气早就伤透了，运化失常，水谷不化，所以腹泻。但我注意到一个细节——患者有黏液便。黏液便不仅仅是湿，是湿热，是瘀毒。所以这不是单纯的脾虚泄泻，是虚实夹杂、湿热瘀毒互结。单纯补脾，湿邪不去，越补越滞；单纯清热，脾气更伤，越清越虚。”

“我会用乌梅丸合白头翁汤加减。乌梅丸寒热并用、攻补兼施，最适合这种寒热错杂、虚实夹杂的慢性腹泻。白头翁汤清热燥湿、凉血解毒，针对黏液便。再加三七、丹参活血化瘀。久病入络，肠道的微小血管长期处于瘀滞状态，不把瘀化开，腹泻就好不了。”

“生活方面，我会建议患者做两件事。第一，每天记录饮食日记，找出诱发腹泻的食物。第二，练习腹式呼吸，每天早晚各十五分钟。肠易激综合征跟情绪高度相关，腹式呼吸能调节自主神经功能，减轻肠道的高敏感性。”

刘教授听完，沉默了几秒，终于正视王大壮夸奖道：“小伙子，真是后生可畏啊，我没问题了！”

随着话音落下，长桌上的气氛变了。

之前那些审视的、怀疑的目光，变成了欣赏和认可。

一位教授拿起钢笔在笔记本上飞快地写了几行字，另一位教授端起茶杯喝了一口，放下杯子时嘴角带着笑意。

张忠义一直没有说话。

他坐在主位上，双手交叠放在桌面上，手指修长，指甲修剪得很整齐，指腹有薄薄的茧，是几十年搭脉留下的痕迹。

他的目光始终落在王大壮身上，不疾不徐，像一个人在认真地

王大壮回答完了所有问题。

他站在那里，看着长桌旁那些白大褂的脸上从审视到认可的表情变化，特别是见孙大夫坐在角落里眼眶泛红却嘴角上扬的样子，心里头也是暗自好笑。

最后，王大壮的视线最后落在张忠义身上，微微欠了欠身，语气谦逊道：“前辈，您说我说的对不对？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This case is more difficult than the previous two.

Irritable bowel syndrome is delayed, long-term illness consumes healthy energy, spleen deficiency, kidney deficiency, liver stagnation, dampness and blood stasis, various pathogenesis are intertwined, and it cannot be cured by simply strengthening the spleen or simply stopping diarrhea.

Wang Dazhuang frowned, thought for a while, and spoke.

"After six years of diarrhea, a long-term illness will lead to deficiency, and a long-term illness will lead to blood stasis. Spleen deficiency is certain. After six years, the spleen has been damaged, and the transportation and transformation are abnormal, and the water and grains are not dissolved, so there is diarrhea. But I noticed one detail - the patient has mucus in the stool. The mucus in the stool is not just wet, but damp and hot, and stasis and toxin. So this is not a simple spleen deficiency and diarrhea, but a mixture of deficiency and excess, dampness, heat and blood stasis. Simply nourishing the spleen will not remove the dampness evil, and the more it is replenished, the more stagnant it becomes; simply clearing away heat will damage the spleen more, and the clearer it is, the more deficient it will be."

"I will use Wumei Wan combined with Pulsatilla Decoction. Wumei Wan is used as a combination of cold and heat, and is used to attack and nourish. It is most suitable for chronic diarrhea with a mixture of cold and heat, deficiency and excess. Pulsatilla Wan Tang clears away heat and dampness, cools blood and detoxifies, and targets mucus stool. Add Panax notoginseng and Salvia miltiorrhiza to activate blood circulation and remove blood stasis. Chronic disease enters the meridians, and the tiny blood vessels in the intestines are in a stagnant state for a long time. If the blood stasis is not removed, the diarrhea will not be cured."

"In terms of daily life, I would advise patients to do two things. First, keep a food diary every day to find out the foods that cause diarrhea. Second, practice abdominal breathing for fifteen minutes in the morning and evening every day. Irritable bowel syndrome is highly related to emotions, and abdominal breathing can regulate autonomic nervous system function and reduce intestinal hypersensitivity."

After hearing this, Professor Liu was silent for a few seconds, and finally looked directly at Wang Dazhuang and praised: "Young man, you are really a formidable young man. I have no problem!"

As the words fell, the atmosphere on the long table changed.

Those scrutinizing and skeptical looks before turned into appreciation and recognition.

One professor picked up a pen and quickly wrote a few lines in his notebook. Another professor took a sip from his tea cup and put down the cup with a smile on his lips.

Zhang Zhongyi remained silent.

He sat on the main seat with his hands folded on the table. His fingers were long and his nails were neatly manicured. There were thin calluses on the fingertips, which were the traces of decades of taking pulses.

His eyes always fell on Wang Dazhuang, neither hurriedly nor slowly, like a man seriously

Wang Dazhuang finished answering all the questions.

He stood there, watching the expressions on the faces of those in white coats at the long table change from scrutiny to approval, especially when he saw Dr. Sun sitting in the corner with red eyes but raised corners of his mouth, and he was secretly amused.

Finally, Wang Dazhuang's eyes fell on Zhang Zhongyi, he bowed slightly and said in a humble tone: "Senior, do you think what I said is correct?"
